focus: Code Quality, Metrics and Memory Safety

entries.logic: Uses Valgrind Memcheck tool to identify unreleased memory and invalid pointer access in C++ binaries.
entries.rationale: Ensures the long-term stability of the Parcel IDE by preventing cumulative resource exhaustion.

entries.logic: Calculates lines of code (LOC), complexity, and comment-to-code ratio using 'cloc' or custom SSQLM tools.
entries.rationale: Provides visibility into technical debt and helps identify monolithic files that need refactoring.

entries.logic: Ensures all .hpp and .h files contain either #pragma once or unique #ifndef/#define guards to prevent double inclusion.
entries.rationale: Reduces compilation time and avoids obscure linker errors in large-scale C++ projects.
